commands: if [ -f "requirements.txt" ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; elif [ -f "backend/requirements.txt" ]; then pip install -r backend/requirements.txt; fi
if [ -d "backend/prisma" ]; then cd backend && prisma generate && cd ..; else prisma generate; fi

deploy.startCommand: if [ -d "backend" ]; then cd backend; fi && (sh start.sh || (python scripts/seed_auth_users.py ; python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT))
